rationale: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry, so this is a conservative baseline built from the contract. Five sensors span x = -0.04 to +0.04 m, ahead of the axle at y = 0.05 m, so the line is seen before the wheels reach it. Weights run -2 to +2 from right to left, so a left-side reading steers left, matching the sign convention. A 12 mm footprint covers the 25 mm tape at the outer sensors without saturating. The drivetrain is sized for stability: 0.12 m track, 0.03 m wheels, 0.8 kg, body 0.12 x 0.18 m. Base speed 1.4 is high enough to reach about 1.5 m/s average. kp 3.0 gives moderate steering, kd 0.3 damps oscillation, and ki 0.05 is small to avoid windup. line_loss 'last_direction' recovers from the line edge in the direction it was last lost. Expected result: completion on the oval and s-bend, with the slalom likely showing the most oscillation and line-loss events. The next iteration should be tuned from rms_error, steering_oscillation and line_loss_events.
